definition.name: save_artifact
definition.description: Save a lasting output — a report, a spec section, a takeoff, an estimate — as an artifact the user keeps and can hand to another agent. Artifacts track a file in your workspace, versioned by name, so later turns refer to them by name instead of re-pasting their content. Pass "from_path" to track a file you already wrote (write_file first), or "content" to have it written to artifacts/<name> in your workspace and tracked. Use one or the other, not both.

name.description: Stable name, unique for this agent (e.g. "clash-report.md" or "reports/q3-takeoff.csv")

type.description: MIME type ("text/markdown", "text/csv", "text/html", "application/json") or a domain type ("aec/takeoff", "aec/clash-report"). A real MIME type lets the user's Artifacts panel render it (formatted markdown, a table, a rendered page) instead of plain text.

content.description: Text to write to your workspace and track. Leave it out when you use from_path.

from_path.description: Instead of content: a workspace file to track (its bytes are not copied). Leave it out when you pass content — content wins if both are given.

description.description: One line on what this artifact is, for the user's list

note.description: Why this version exists — shown in the version history

definition.name: update_artifact
definition.description: Record a new version of a tracked artifact. Identify it by "name" or "id", then give either the complete new content (not a patch) in "content" (rewrites the tracked file), or a different workspace file to track with "from_path" — one or the other, not both. Give neither to record the tracked file's current state after you edited it yourself with edit_file/write_file.

name.description: Name of the artifact to update (or use id)

id.description: Id of the artifact to update (or use name)

content.description: The complete new content, written to the tracked file. Leave it out to track without rewriting.

from_path.description: Instead of content: a different workspace file to track from now on. Leave it out when you pass content — content wins if both are given.

note.description: What changed in this version — shown in the version history

expected_version.description: Only update if this is still the current version number; otherwise the call fails

definition.name: read_artifact
definition.description: Read an artifact's tracked file, live from your workspace. Use this instead of keeping a long deliverable in the conversation: refer to the artifact by name and read it when you need it.

name.description: Name of the artifact (or use id)

id.description: Id of the artifact (or use name)

max_bytes.description: Most bytes of content to return

definition.name: list_artifacts
definition.description: List the artifacts you have made — name, type, version, size and description, newest first. Check this before saving, so you update an existing deliverable instead of creating a near-duplicate.

tags.description: Only artifacts carrying any of these tags

this_session_only.description: Only artifacts first created in this conversation
